method: AI self-review of all newly authored translations against the implemented menu, dialog, clipboard states and native-share payload. Consulted the maintained terminology guide and official provider integration references. This is not independent review or native-speaker certification.
scope: 14 new sharing messages in Simplified Chinese, Korean and Japanese; existing Close translation reused unchanged. No earlier UI copy, README or song alias was re-reviewed or changed.

Share this site.context_review: Action label names the site rather than the current chart or player profile; concise in all three languages.

Share the public homepage. Your player d.context_review: Public-homepage scope and exclusions retained in all languages; matches the constant URL and payload.

Website link.context_review: Accessible name describes the read-only homepage URL field.

Copy link.context_review: Conventional clipboard action label; does not imply the link was already copied.

Link copied.context_review: Completion message is shown only after the clipboard write succeeds.

Share with device….context_review: Invokes the operating-system share picker, distinct from provider links; ellipsis retained.

More….context_review: Additional sharing destinations rather than automatic publication; contextual label with ellipsis.

Social services open in a new tab. More.context_review: Discloses new-tab navigation and the external provider; AddToAny spelling preserved.

Explore maimai charts, patterns, and per.context_review: Generic site invitation, with guide-consistent chart terms 谱面 / 채보 / 譜面; contains no personal results.

Copy the selected link using your device.context_review: Manual recovery instruction does not falsely claim clipboard success; selected URL remains visible.

KakaoTalk.context_review: Localized recognizable service labels; provider code remains kakao.

Naver.context_review: Regional brand spelling kept separate from the official Naver endpoint.

WeChat.context_review: Uses 微信 in Simplified Chinese and 위챗 in Korean; no promise of automatic posting.

Weibo.context_review: Uses 微博 in Simplified Chinese and 웨이보 in Korean; service identifier is not translated.

invariants_review: LINE, X, Hatena, Qzone, Facebook, WhatsApp, Messenger and Reddit retain brand spelling. MacIntel is a browser identifier, not translatable prose. Tab was reviewed as a KeyboardEvent.key identifier in the focus handler, not a label requiring translation.
limitations: Actual delivery inside social apps is not a language-review result.

supplemental_invariant_reviews.scope: Tab is the standard KeyboardEvent.key identifier in the share-dialog focus handler. All 14 sharing messages and their translations remain unchanged.
supplemental_invariant_reviews.method: AI code and protocol review; no translation or native-speaker certification added.
